summary: Eastern US Lookouts says the Aucilla tower in Madison County sold at auction in 2008; a USGS site carries its name; no source describes the site now.

events.note: Sold at auction, per the Eastern US Lookouts listing; the listing does not give the buyer or the tower's later state.

evidence.supports: Listing carries the code T1S R6E

evidence.quote: 2008: The tower was sold at auction.

evidence.supports: USGS monitoring location named Aucilla Fire Tower, Adc.
evidence.quote: Location name AUCILLA FIRE TOWER, ADC.

evidence.supports: USGS site is in Madison County

sources.title: Aucilla Fire Tower, Adc. - USGS Water Data for the Nation (monitoring location 302529083415701)

corrections.why: The listing gives T1S R6E as a code in the agency position; it names no managing agency.

notes_for_editor: The Eastern US Lookouts entry is a stub: county, a survey code and a 2008 auction note. The USGS monitoring location (lat 30.4249, lon -83.6990) carries the tower's name but gives no date and says nothing about a tower. A 2017 Perry Newspapers snippet describes a 510-acre fire in southern Madison County first seen from a forest-service fire tower, but it names no tower and the article is paywalled, so it is not cited. A realstack property listing gives an address on SW Aucilla Fire Tower Road, Greenville, FL 32331; it was not read or cited. The story is about 60 words, well under the 120-word target. Worth checking Florida Forest Service records for the 2008 sale and the tower's fate.
